AddressType.title: 数据地址类型。
AddressType.description:
The type of the data address. Valid values:

Object storage: oss, s3, qiniu, cos, bos, obs, ks3, ucloud, upyun, azure, gcp, and tos.

File storage: local, obsfs, and ftp.

Checklist: inv.

Domain.title: 数据存储空间的域名。
Domain.description: The domain name of the data storage bucket.

Role.title: 授权角色。数据存储空间是OSS时，可以指定授权角色，无需指定存储空间的AK。
Role.description: The authorized role. If the data is stored in an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket, you can specify an authorized role. This removes the need to specify the AccessKey pair for the bucket.

InvDomain.title: 列表存储空间的域名。
InvDomain.description: The domain name of the manifest bucket.

InvBucket.title: 列表存储空间。
InvBucket.description: The bucket that contains the inventory list.

InvAccessId.title: 列表存储空间AccessKeyId。
InvAccessId.description: The AccessKey ID of the manifest bucket.

InvAccessSecret.title: 列表存储空间SecretAccessKey。
InvAccessSecret.description: The AccessKey secret of the manifest bucket.

InvPath.title: 列表清单文件。指定清单列表和格式。
InvPath.description: The manifest file. Specifies the manifest and its format.

InvRole.title: 列表存储空间授权角色。列表存储空间是OSS时，可以指定授权角色，无需指定列表存储空间的AK。
InvRole.description: The authorized role for the manifest bucket. If the manifest is stored in an OSS bucket, you can specify an authorized role. This removes the need to specify the AccessKey pair for the manifest bucket.

InvLocation.title: 列表存储空间类型。取值：oss，s3，cos。
InvLocation.description:
The type of the manifest bucket.
Valid values: oss and s3.

AgentList.title: 关联代理。通过专线/VPN等方式访问数据，需要关联代理。
AgentList.description: The associated proxy. If you access data over a leased line or a VPN, you must associate a proxy.

RegionId.title: 数据存储空间区域。数据存储空间是OSS时，必须指定存储空间区域，无需指定存储空间域名。
RegionId.description: The region of the data storage bucket. If the data is stored in an OSS bucket, you must specify the bucket region. Use the OSS-specific region ID format. You do not need to specify the bucket's domain name.

InvRegionId.title: 列表存储空间区域。列表存储空间是OSS时，必须指定列表存储空间区域，无需指定列表存储空间域名。
InvRegionId.description: The region of the manifest bucket. If the manifest is stored in an OSS bucket, you must specify the manifest bucket region. Use the OSS-specific region ID format. You do not need to specify the manifest bucket's domain name.

DataType.title: 通用清单使用，当AddressType是inv时，DataType表示实际的存储类型，可取值为： oss、s3等
DataType.description: This parameter is used for general inventories. If AddressType is set to inv, DataType specifies the actual storage type. Valid values include oss, s3, and obs.

LogMode.title: 日志推送。取值： off，不推送日志；basic，仅推送文件迁移失败日志；detail，推送文件迁移成功和失败日志。推送迁移日志到SLS，需要创建AliyunOSSImportSlsAuditRole角色，并对角色完成授权。
LogMode.description: Specifies whether to push migration logs to Simple Log Service (SLS). To push migration logs to SLS, you must create the AliyunOSSImportSlsAuditRole role and grant the required permissions to the role. Valid values: off, basic, and detail. off: does not push migration logs. basic: pushes only migration failure logs. detail: pushes migration success logs and migration failure logs.

CreateAddressInfo.title: 创建数据地址详情。
CreateAddressInfo.description: The information about the data address.

Name.title: 数据地址名称。取值：英文小写字母、数字和特殊字符-和_，最短 3 字符， 最长 63 个字符，区分大小写，utf8 编码并且不可以- 和_开头，不能为空。
Name.description:
The name of the data address.\
The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length. The name is case-sensitive and encoded in UTF-8. The name cannot start with a hyphen (-) or an underscore (\_). You must specify a name.

AddressDetail.title: 数据地址详情。
AddressDetail.description: The details of the data address.

Tags.title: 标签，KeyValue格式。 允许字符：英文大小写字母、数字和特殊字符-_,。长度限制：1KB。
Tags.description:
The tags in the key:value format.\
The value can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (\_), and commas (,). The value can be up to 1,024 characters in length.

Name.title: 代理名称。取值：英文小写字母、数字和特殊字符-和_，最短 3 字符， 最长 63 个字符，区分大小写，utf8 编码并且不可以- 和_开头，不能为空。
Name.description:
The name of the agent.\
The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length. The name is case-sensitive and encoded in UTF-8. The name cannot start with a hyphen (-) or an underscore (\_). You must specify a name.

DeployMethod.title: 代理的部署方式。取值：default。
DeployMethod.description:
The deployment mode of the agent.\
Set the value to default, which specifies the independent process mode.

AgentEndpoint.title: 代理访问方式，支持公网，专线/VPN等。取值：public，vpc。
AgentEndpoint.description:
The method that is used to access the agent.\
Valid values: public and vpc.

Tags.title: 标签，KeyValue格式。 允许字符：英文大小写字母、数字和特殊字符-_,。长度限制：1KB。
Tags.description:
The tags in the key:value format.\
The value can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (\_), and commas (,). The value can be up to 1,024 characters in length.

CreateJobInfo.title: 创建迁移任务详情。
CreateJobInfo.description: Details of the migration task to create.

Name.title: 任务名称。取值：英文小写字母、数字和特殊字符-和_，最短 3 字符， 最长 63 个字符，区分大小写，utf8 编码并且不可以- 和_开头，不能为空。
Name.description:
The task name.
The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name is case-sensitive and must be UTF-8 encoded. It cannot start with a hyphen (-) or an underscore (\_). This parameter cannot be empty.

SrcAddress.title: 源数据地址名称。
SrcAddress.description: The name of the source data address.

DestAddress.title: 目的数据地址名称。
DestAddress.description: The name of the destination data address.

OverwriteMode.title: 文件覆盖方式。取值：never，不覆盖；always，覆盖；
OverwriteMode.description:
The file overwrite mode.
Valid values: \`never\` and \`always\`. \`never\`: Does not overwrite existing files. \`always\`: Overwrites existing files.

TransferMode.title: 文件传输方式。取值：all，强制覆盖；lastmodified，根据最后修改时间覆盖。 OverwriteMode与TransferMode结合使用，分别设置： always，all：强制覆盖 always, lastmodified：根据文件最后修改时间覆盖 never，all：不覆盖。
TransferMode.description:
The file transfer mode.
Valid values: \`all\` (full transfer) and \`lastmodified\` (incremental transfer).
\`OverwriteMode\` and \`TransferMode\` are used together:

- \`always\` and \`all\`: Forces a full overwrite. - \`always\` and \`lastmodified\`: Overwrites files based on their last modified time. - \`never\` and an empty value for \`TransferMode\`: Does not overwrite files with the same name.

Tags.title: 标签，KeyValue格式。 允许字符：英文大小写字母、数字和特殊字符-_,。长度限制：1KB。
Tags.description:
The tags, in key-value format.
Allowed characters include uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The maximum length is 1024 characters.

ParentVersion.title: 父任务ID。创建失败文件重试子任务时可以指定父任务ID。
ParentVersion.description: The parent task ID. Specify this ID when you create a subtask to retry failed file transfers.

ConvertSymlinkTarget.title: 是否转换软链接Target。当源和目的数据地址是oss到local，local到oss，local到local时，可以指定转换软链接Target，使得迁移后的软链接能够正常访问。
ConvertSymlinkTarget.description: Specifies whether to transform the target of a symbolic link. When migrating data from OSS to a local server, from a local server to OSS, or between two local servers, set this parameter to \`true\` to ensure that symbolic links can be accessed after migration.

EnableMultiVersioning.title: 是否迁移多版本。暂不支持多版本迁移。
EnableMultiVersioning.description: Specifies whether to migrate multiple object versions. Multi-version migration is not supported.

CreateReport.title: 是否创建迁移报告。
CreateReport.description: Specifies whether to create a migration report.

WithStorageClass.description: Specifies whether to migrate the StorageClass property. This is allowed only for OSS-to-OSS migration.

Status.description:
The status of the job.

IMPORT\_JOB\_BEGIN: The job is created.

AppendableToNormal.description: Specifies whether to migrate appendable files as normal or multipart files. The default value is false.

GetJobResultResp.title: 任务重试信息详情。
GetJobResultResp.description: The results of a migration job, including retry information for failed files and migration statistics.

ReadyRetry.title: 失败文件是否可重试。取值：NoNeed，无需重试；Ready，失败文件列表准备完成；NotReady，失败文件列表准备中。
ReadyRetry.description: The retry readiness status for failed files. Valid values: NoNeed indicates that all files were migrated successfully and no retry is required. Ready indicates that the failed file list has been generated and is available for retry. NotReady indicates that the failed file list is being generated.

InvPath.title: 失败文件列表清单文件。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvPath字段。
InvPath.description: The path to the manifest file that lists the failed files. Use this value as the InvPath parameter when you create a data address for a retry job.

InvBucket.title: 失败文件列表存储空间。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvBucket字段。
InvBucket.description: The name of the bucket that stores the failed file list. Use this value as the InvBucket parameter when you create a data address for a retry job.

InvDomain.title: 失败文件列表存储空间域名。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvDomain字段。
InvDomain.description: The endpoint of the bucket that stores the failed file list. Use this value as the InvDomain parameter when you create a data address for a retry job.

InvLocation.title: 失败文件列表存储空间类型。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvLocation字段。
InvLocation.description: The storage type of the bucket that stores the failed file list, such as oss. Use this value as the InvLocation parameter when you create a data address for a retry job.

InvAccessId.title: 失败文件列表存储空间的AccessKeyId。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvAccessId字段。
InvAccessId.description: The AccessKey ID that is used to access the bucket where the failed file list is stored. Use this value as the InvAccessId parameter when you create a data address for a retry job.

InvAccessSecret.title: 失败文件列表存储空间的SecretAccessKey。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvAccessSecret字段。
InvAccessSecret.description: The AccessKey secret that is used to access the bucket where the failed file list is stored. Use this value as the InvAccessSecret parameter when you create a data address for a retry job.

InvRegionId.title: 失败文件存储空间区域。构造新的数据地址时，填入InvRegionId字段。
InvRegionId.description: The region ID of the bucket that stores the failed file list. Use this value as the InvRegionId parameter when you create a data address for a retry job.

AddressType.title: 根据失败文件列表构造的地址类型。构造新的数据地址时，填入AddressType字段。
AddressType.description: The data address type for the retry job. This value indicates that the data address is constructed from a failed file inventory. Use this value as the AddressType parameter when you create a data address for a retry job.

SuspendCronExpression.description: The time when the migration task paused. You can use a CRON expression to specify the time. The interval at which the migration task is run is at least 1 hour.

MaxScheduleCount.title: 自动调度轮次限制，任务执行ID在轮次限制内（任务从开始到结束为一轮执行）会根据启动时间和暂停时间自动调度，超过轮次限制不再自动调度，但是依然可以手动执行。
MaxScheduleCount.description: The maximum number of times that the migration task is automatically scheduled. Each time the migration task is run, the execution ID increases by one until the task is run the specified number of times. The task is automatically scheduled based on the specified start time and pause time. The task is no longer automatically scheduled after the task is run the specified number of times. However, you can still manually start the task.

StartTime.title: 开始时间。

MaxQps.description:
The maximum queries per second (QPS) of the tunnel.\
Valid values: values greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0. The default value indicates that the QPS of the tunnel is not limited.

MaxBandwidth.title: 通道的带宽限流，单位 Byte/s。 取值：不低于10485760 （10MBps) 。默认值是0，表示不受限制。
MaxBandwidth.description:

Valid values: values greater than or equal to 10485760. Default value: 0. The default value indicates that the bandwidth of the tunnel is not limited.

CreateAgent.title: CreateAgent
CreateAgent.description:
*   To create an agent, you must have the permission on mgw:CreateImportAgent.
*   If you want to migrate data to Alibaba Cloud over an Express Connect circuit or a VPN gateway, or migrate data from a self-managed storage space to Alibaba Cloud, you can deploy an agent.
*   Before you create an agent, you must create a tunnel. An agent must be associated with a tunnel.

schema.description: The request body for creating the migration task.

ImportJob.description: The details for creating the migration task.

CreateJob.title: CreateJob
CreateJob.description:
*   To create a migration task, you must have the permission on mgw:CreateImportJob.
*   Before you create a migration task, you must create data addresses.
*   A migration task can run multiple rounds. Each round has an execution ID.

schema.description: The request body for creating the migration report.

CreateReport.title: CreateReport
CreateReport.description:
*   To create a migration report, you must have the permission on mgw:CreateImportReport.
*   If you specify that a migration report is to be generated when you create a migration task, you do not need to call this operation. If you do not specify that a migration report is to be generated when you create a migration task, you can call this operation to create a migration report for an execution with the specified ID.

schema.description: The request body for creating the tunnel.

CreateTunnel.title: CreateTunnel
CreateTunnel.description:
*   To create a tunnel, you must have the permission on mgw:CreateImportTunnel.
*   When you use an agent to migrate data, the agent must be associated with a tunnel.
*   A tunnel can be associated with multiple agents. You can throttle the traffic of the agents that are associated with the same tunnel by setting the bandwidth and the number of requests per second for the tunnel.
CreateTunnel.responseParamsDescription: If the tunnel is created, a tunnel ID is returned in the response header x-oss-import-tunnel-id.
